idFeatures: Bold dark lateral stripe from eye to tail
behaviour: Prefers deep offshore waters; fast and acrobatic.

Deep-water species; seen in large fast-moving schools.

behaviour: Slow, gliding surface behaviour; often seen with head above water.

idFeatures: Jet black with grey saddle patch

behaviour: Cooperative hunter; shares food. Fast and sometimes bow-rides. Can hybridise with bottlenose dolphins.

idFeatures: Cape pattern from forehead to flank
